scenario: The same progress:done envelope for a node is delivered twice (e.g. a mailbox redelivery after an ack was lost). The second delivery must be a no-op — exactly one state transition to done, no double-counted completion, no error surfaced from the harmless duplicate.

steps.event: progress: done envelope (request_id X) delivered for n1
steps.expect: n1 transitions in-progress -> done exactly once; the transition is recorded against request_id X

steps.event: the identical progress: done envelope (same request_id X) is delivered again
steps.expect: the duplicate is recognized (same request_id already settled) and dropped as a no-op — n1 stays done, no second transition is recorded, no error is raised

steps.event: the mission's completion count is read
steps.expect: n1 counts once toward mission completion, not twice
